The thinking behind the shelf

How it works

Readers with similar tastes often discover books together. Recommendations here draw on reader ratings and patterns of similarity between books, then offer a little room for surprise.

A personal project

About the project

Afterword is a personal analytics and recommendation-system project built with Python and SQL. This preview uses sample books and mock recommendations; a real ratings dataset can be connected later.
